title: Hermes Agent (default)
description: Hermes Agent on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: Hermes Agent (Standard)
de.description: Hermes Agent an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: the Nous Portal (your login: sandbox-ai login hermes once); its hosts are open by default, nothing else of the provider's. A server of yours instead: the preset hermes-local-llm.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-hermes or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build hermes (a start builds it when it is missing).
